rationale: logsquickmode.spec.js covers the Quick Mode menu toggle / interesting-fields / SQL-mode behaviors, but has a heavy beforeEach (enableQuickModeIfDisabled + clickAllFields) and no coverage of the new pin-to-toolbar behavior (SearchBar.vue pin button -> logs-search-bar-quick-mode-pinned-toggle-btn). The pin feature is a distinct sub-feature with different setup (default pinned state must be normalized via localStorage clear). run-context supplies a dedicated spec_filename/spec_path (logsQuickModePin.spec.js), so a new spec under Logs-Core is the least-duplicative fit. Needs registration: add logsQuickModePin.spec.js to the Logs-Core run_files list in .github/workflows/playwright.yml.
